EffectAddress.description: Canonical address of one admitted runtime effect.

ExecutionNodeKind.description:
Closed vocabulary of executable workflow sites.

This describes the site, not its current observation. A workflow node may
expose more than one site kind. Declaration order is the canonical order:
a node's execution sites sort by it, so reordering the variants changes
the serialized workflow graph and needs a graph schema bump.

ExecutionScope.description:
Stable semantic identity for one effectful runtime operation.

This is the scope admitted by the host boundary before nondeterministic
work begins. Its journal encoding is an existing durable contract; effect
addresses compose it with a replay key without changing those bytes.

oneOf.description:
One operation on a session that runs no turn: a host command, named
by its batch, or the admissions of one shift request. It has no
logical root, and no logical turn runs under it.

ExprSlot.description:
The role one child expression plays in its parent expression of the
shared workflow IR.

The body of a loop, a function, a process literal or a `try`.
The input of a host descriptor constructor.
A call argument, by position.
The single operand of a unary form.
The computed member a method call reads its callee from.
The collection a map intrinsic reads.
The callback a map intrinsic applies.

RunAggregateWakePolicy.description:
Aggregate wake rule. Run-owned aggregates preserve these semantics;
the rule does not require a durable group dispatcher.

`Promise.all` and `Promise.allSettled` both use [`All`](Self::All): the
caller's early exit on rejection is not a host wake rule. The wire shape
has no default, so a missing rule cannot be replayed under a guess.

oneOf.description: Wake on the first settlement of any kind.
Wake on the first success, or after every child fails.
Deliver every settlement in durable rank order.

oneOf.description:

TraceLanguageExecutionFailure.description: The observed cause of a failed language node.

oneOf.description:
A dispatched tool effect failed with its recorded classification and
recorded source and delay hint. `replay_key` is the causing effect's identity.
A VM or host-boundary failure with a stable runtime error code.

TraceLanguageExecutionMap.description:
The static graph of an execution, carried once on
[`TraceLanguageExecutionPayload::ExecutionStarted`]. Identity
(`module_ref`, `entry_kind`, `entry_ref`, `entry_name`) lives solely on the
enclosing [`TraceLanguageExecutionIdentity`]; the map never repeats it.

branch_memberships.description: Observed branch selections that admit this node's arm.

TraceLashlangEdgeSelection.description:
Observed branch-edge selection state.

Only the edge a `BranchSelected` event names is marked. There is no
`Rejected`: the execution map carries data-dependency and sequencing edges
(ADR 0037) and nothing marks an edge as a branch arm, so an unselected arm
is indistinguishable from an ordinary edge leaving the same node. Which arm
ran is read from the typed selection on the branch node itself
([`TraceLashlangGraphNode::branch_selection`]).

TraceLashlangEventIdentity.description:
Canonical identity of one fold input.

Node transitions use `(node_id, site_path, node_kind, occurrence,
attempt)` plus the transition kind: occurrences count per site, so two
sites of one node are never one identity. The transition kind lets a start and its terminal
fact merge monotonically while still making a second, different start or
terminal a typed conflict.

TraceLashlangGraphChildLink.description: Link from an observed parent Lash VM node to a child execution graph.

TraceLashlangGraphCompleteness.description: Whether the static execution map was available to the fold.

TraceLashlangGraphConflict.description: A bounded, typed record of divergent values under one logical identity.

TraceLashlangGraphConflictKind.description: Why two records under one logical identity did not deduplicate.

TraceLashlangGraphHistoryEvent.description: One canonical event retained so a persisted snapshot can be folded again.

oneOf.description:
The process settled without complete terminal evidence for this
observed occurrence. The category is authoritative; node success,
failure and timing are not inferred from it.

branch_selection.description:
Which arm a branch node took, copied from the typed `selected` field of
the `BranchSelected` event. Absent on every other node, and on a branch
whose selection has not been observed yet.

TraceLashlangGraphSettlement.description:
Terminal evidence supplied by a committed process fact or durable snapshot.
This does not manufacture a language execution or node observation.

occurred_at.description: None when the snapshot has no canonical terminal occurrence time.

TraceLashlangGraphTerminal.description: The actual durable terminal category; abandonment is not a VM failure.

TraceLashlangNodeRetention.description: Aggregate facts for occurrences evicted from one node's bounded history.

WorkflowExecutionSite.description:
One execution site of a workflow node: the node (`owner` and `path`), the
exact executable subexpression inside its statement (`site_path`), and a
description of what runs there. `kind` and `label` describe the site; they
are not its identity.

WorkflowLoopFrame.description: One enclosing loop of an occurrence, outermost first in a context.

activation.description:
Which entry of that loop this is, unique within the execution: a loop
reentered by an outer iteration gets a new activation.

WorkflowLoopPosition.description: Where inside one loop activation something ran. Numbers are one-based.

oneOf.description:
The `n`-th evaluation of a `while` condition. The check after the last
body iteration, which reads false, is a check with no body of its
number.
The `n`-th run of the loop body.

WorkflowOccurrenceContext.description:
Where one occurrence of a site ran, beyond its node: the exact site
inside the node's statement and the loop activations that enclosed the
occurrence when it began, outermost first. The default is a node's own
statement site outside every loop.

WorkflowSitePath.description:
The typed path from a workflow node's statement to one executable
subexpression. The empty path is the statement itself.

Slot segments walk the statement's typed child slots; a trailing role
segment names a synthetic site of the expression they reach.

WorkflowSiteRef.description:
The static address of one execution site in a workflow document: the node
that owns it and the path to the executable subexpression inside it.

WorkflowSiteRole.description: What a site that is not an expression of its own stands for.

oneOf.description:
The step a label declares over the expression it wraps, when that
expression is not itself the labeled operation.
A typed child slot of the expression reached so far.
A site the expression reached so far owns beside its own.
